text: Is GSE309890 the same thing as GDS309890?

## Abstract
This investigation addresses whether GEO accessions GSE309890 and GDS309890 refer to the same dataset. Using the NCBI GEO database accession resolution tool, both GSE and GDS accession types were queried. GSE and GDS represent different GEO record types: GSE corresponds to GEO Series, while GDS denotes GEO DataSet entries. The results show distinct accession types and unique NCBI UIDs for each, confirming they are separate and not interchangeable entities. This differentiation is essential for researchers relying on correct GEO accession types for data retrieval and downstream analysis.

## I. Introduction
Background: The Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) archives functional genomic datasets, each with multiple accession types reflecting distinct data entities. GSE accessions refer to series of experiments (Series), while GDS accessions correspond to curated datasets (DataSets). Confusion between accession types can lead to misinterpretation or retrieval of inappropriate data.

Literature Review: No literature was retrieved for this query.

Knowledge Gap: The specific relationship or equivalence between GSE309890 and GDS309890 was unclear prior to querying GEO accession records.

Objective & Hypothesis: To determine if GSE309890 and GDS309890 are identical or represent different records in GEO. The hypothesis is that they are different given the distinct accession prefixes.

## II. Materials and Methods
Study Design: Direct query of GEO accession resolution service to fetch full metadata for the two accessions.

Materials: NCBI GEO accession resolver (geo_resolve_accession).

Procedures: The tool was called with accessions "GSE309890" and "GDS309890" to obtain their entry types, unique database identifiers (UIDs), and FTP URLs.

Statistical Analysis: Comparison based on UID and entry_type fields for unequivocal differentiation.

## III. Results

| Accession  | UID      | Entry Type | GEO URL                                                       |
|------------|----------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| GSE309890  | 200309890| GSE (Series)| https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890  |
| GDS309890  | 309890   | GDS (DataSet)| https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GDS309890  |

The two accessions correspond to different GEO entry types with separate UIDs and URLs.

## IV. Discussion
Interpretation: The data demonstrate that GSE309890 and GDS309890 are distinct entries within GEO, representing different categories of GEO data.

Context: This aligns with GEO's naming conventions where GSE denotes series and GDS denotes curated datasets.

Limitations: The query did not explore the content overlap or relationship between these two accessions beyond metadata.

Conclusion & Future Directions: GSE309890 is not the same as GDS309890. Future analysis may investigate whether the GDS entry derives from or is related to the GSE series data.

## References
[1] NCBI GEO accession resolver: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890  
[2] NCBI GEO accession resolver: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GDS309890  

## Acknowledgments
Data provided by the NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database.
